scope: Original graphical abstract and two-page brief, rendered inspection plus vector/font geometry. No source, figure, canonical product, raw photometry, FITS/header, fit, data-access, commit or board mutation.

print_geometry.note: Visible graphic content is inset within the SVG. Comparing visible bounds with the PDF image bounds would underestimate font size; native-versus-embedded word widths give the actual full 170 mm embedding.

keep: The beeswarm/log-axis hero communicates the spread of planet maxima while preserving the one isolated gross miss.
The question-led title, four simple method icons, blue cluster and labelled vermilion outlier establish a useful hierarchy.
The card medians across all timings remain distinct from the per-planet maximum represented by each dot; keep those denominators explicit.
Approximately 40% of the page text height is a reasonable allocation at the current aspect ratio and two-page constraint.

colour_and_grayscale.note: No independent claim about the reported CVD delta-E calculation is made; the reading survives absence of colour from its redundant visual encoding.

findings.finding: Secondary copy prints at about6.5–7pt. Main chart is readable but its supporting labels are small for the brief audience.
findings.proposed_fix: Raise small SVG copy to at least 16 px, about 7.7 pt at full 170 mm embedding, shortening subtitle/callout copy as needed. Full-width placement is already correct.

findings.finding: Muted axis/caption text is less legible at small print size than the dark secondary text.
findings.proposed_fix: Use the existing dark #4b535c secondary colour for critical axis/caption/scope copy; keep #7a828b for rules/arrows.

findings.finding: The generic1–4h duration band visually resembles cohort-measured context, but cohort durations were not established.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove it as parent intends; use the recovered space for accepted-sample scope. Existing 1-hour and 6-hour ticks retain understandable scale.

findings.finding: A stand-alone graphical abstract gives undercoverage and an accuracy success but omits the inconclusive primary widening result.
findings.proposed_fix: A short readable footer such as Wider ranges: score improvement inconclusive would complete the scientific message without a fourth card. If preserving readable labels makes that infeasible, keep the result prominent in the adjacent brief text.

findings.finding: Current labels say every prediction and every transit, 26 minutes, and of each planet. These must be fixed before final output; the parent already identified the evidence issues.
findings.proposed_fix: Accepted timings scored; allaccepted timings within 26.4 minutes for 150 planets; 91% averaged over planets with measurement uncertainty included; distinct published timetable for neighbouring planet.

final_QA_needed: Parent should render the corrected full brief and standalone figure, inspect both final pages and remeasure minimum print type after font/layout changes. This receipt reviews the original source, not unobserved revised output.
